method: Live production, Chromium Pixel 7 emulation at 390x844, desktop CPU and unthrottled host network. Two independent cold browser contexts per page (three for POS), each followed by a same-context full reload with cache retained. Authenticated; login, DNS and server cold-start excluded. Page timings run serially with one page open; all timing pages close before passive idle/sync observations start. First-pair browser profiles retain HTTP/storage caches for separate idle tabs. Idle observations run sequentially with one page open, outside all page timing windows. Initial/API idle counts use request initiation time; static assets excluded. Repeat visits preserve the browser session rather than reinjecting stale actor metadata.
